items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: the man that's going to manage us after we get to New York is Irwin Rosen

ctx.x: So I go to Buck's mother and I get the guardian papers for Buck which she signs and everything and we get him out of school and I get my mother and all to get to the manager and everything and get the contract signed. They're going to pay my mother $35 a week and all expenses for me -- gonna give $35 a week to each mother. It was like a godsend to me, but not knowing what I know after getting to New

York. However, I take Buck's clothes and put them in my trunk so we'll only have one trunk with both sets of clothes. We go to to the railroad station to catch the train with roller skates. We catch the train and go to New York with the man and they got a man in New York to meet us -- I can't think of his name but the man that's going to manage us after we get to New York is Irwin Rosen, that's his name and he was in a band but nobody knew but him about it, I didn't know it. However, they don't get no bookings…

at the most.
So we go back to New York, hang around for a while and it would come the end of the week, we'd go down to get the money in the office to pay our rent and the man says -- he has the office open and a vestibule, where people sit in the vestibule and wait while you go into the office to talk to the manager who he had looking after us. So we go into the office to talk to the man to get the money to pay the bill and he wants to know if we think money grows on trees. So I says, no, I don't think that. What…
